small_guidance:
- Reorder loops so the OC matmul becomes a `tl.dot`: load weight tile [BLOCK_OC, IC*KD*KH*KW] and an im2col-style input tile [IC*KD*KH*KW, BLOCK_HW] per `od`, do a single `tl.dot` instead of the scalar `wv[:,None]*xv[None,:]` accumulation that currently runs IC*KD*KH*KW = 81 outer-product updates per od.
- Add autotune configs with larger `BLOCK_HW` (256) and split `BLOCK_K` (e.g., 27/54/81) for the GEMM-K loop; sweep num_warps∈{4,8} num_stages∈{2,3,4}. Keep `BLOCK_OC=32` (next_pow2(24)).
- Precompute `oh`, `ow`, and per-(kh,kw) input row offsets once outside the `od` loop; only the `id_*H*W` term changes per od/kd.
large_guidance:
- Recast as an implicit-im2col GEMM: one program per (N, OC tile, OH*OW tile). For each output spatial column, treat the 81-element (IC*KD*KH*KW) reduction as the GEMM-K axis and call `tl.dot(W_tile, X_tile)`. Iterate `od` outside, taking `tl.minimum` of the resulting [BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_HW] tile, then fuse the channel-axis softmax in the epilogue (already done).
- Use channels-last-style packing for the weight (shape [OC, IC*KD*KH*KW]) and a contiguous (N, D, H, W, IC) layout-aware gather so loads along K coalesce; weight can be reshaped once in `__init__`.
- Persist the per-program min accumulator in registers across all OD iterations (avoid rematerializing) and emit softmax directly without a second pass — the OC dim (24) easily fits in one tile.
